records.researcher_notes: The draft state air construction permit says Sherlock will install up to 14 combustion turbines. This agrees with GEM. The newest permit is the draft Kansas air construction permit for Sherlock Gas Plant, source 0550199, with public comments due October 26, 2026. It covers up to 14 natural gas simple cycle turbines of 44.5 megawatts each, 623 megawatts in all. This matches GEM in engine count, capacity per engine and total. GEM has one unit row and the permit does not split the fleet into phases. Status stays pre-construction. The project is moving, so Latest Activity is left alone. I found no EIA plant code or generator ID for it.
